Integer multiplication below n log n

AI-generated guide. It may contain errors or inaccuracies. Check important statements and proofs against the original paper.

Fixed linear networks save on both data movement and simultaneous butterflies; controlled errors are then removed by exact recovery.

The manuscript reduces integer multiplication to multidimensional normalized convolutions and accelerates both their tape layout changes and their arithmetic layers. Its central mechanism turns a rank deficit in a fixed linear network into an improved exponent in a recurrence normalized by the stored bit volume. This article explains the author's proof construction; it does not constitute an independent verification of the complete proof.

2. Exact address interchanges and deterministic exception repair

For the bit network, whole rows retaining their complete suffixes are distributed cyclically among roles. Each child has the same address set and of its parent's bit volume. For a width , time divided by volume satisfies

A lower-triangular factorization reduces a rational shear of rank to exactly smaller interchanges; this is why the number of children is the rank sum. Lemma 12 obtains rows from high digits, pads them, partitions widths in base , and pads binary ranges to a fixed odd-prime radix. It thereby interchanges arbitrary nonadjacent width- chunks in time. Intermediate XOR strings are not interpreted as numerical coefficients; arithmetic resumes only after the encodings have been exactly permuted.

The numerical network also needs simultaneous XORs on selected bits of many chunks. Lemma 13 uses eight controlled cyclic shifts with a third chunk as auxiliary space. Addresses near a guard boundary constitute at most of the array. These exceptions are extracted, assigned their correct destinations, stably sorted by binary keys, and reinserted. Every exception is repaired deterministically, independently of payload values; there is no allowed failure probability. The conditions and a long polynomial payload absorb the extra repair and address-computation costs.

A fixed family of role tapes is reused at every recursion depth. Inactive streams are parked at the top of a stack, then popped back in their original order after the child returns. Ancestors' parked data are not rescanned; copies, rewinds, and cleanup are charged to the current node's volume.
